decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk extends the firm's established office line and has its own page, so the option is cheap to keep while demand for flexible workplaces is still resolving.
The chair family sits close to the core offer and shares production and materials, so holding it costs little and it already has visible market presence.
Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory whose value is still uncertain, but they cost little to keep after only one year, so the option stays open for now.
The sofa is close to the core upholstery competence, yet it is only mentioned rather than featured, which signals weaker commitment; it stays while results are still unclear.
The high standing table fits the conference and office range at low incremental cost and has a page of its own, so there is no strong signal yet that its value will not be realized.
The rug collection is distant from the firm's competences and carries the most uncertainty, but one year is too soon to judge it and a curated collection is cheap to hold, so it is kept under watch.
